strengths: A single continuous park, curving path, tree canopy and warm upper-right light unite the bench, workshop and rest vignette. Background softness gives the foreground coder plausible depth.

Largest cream face, glasses, hand-to-laptop arrangement and isolated right bench keep personal mascot dominance at 1280/880/420. Four guests remain subordinate; no foreground guest enters the coding bench.
Repeated cream head, unequal green paddle antennae and marked wings plausibly link the three moth appearances. No visibly aged moth is needed for the owner’s metaphor.
Muse has dark eyes and Grok has two flat pupil-free white ovals in the enlarged crop; neither needs another eye redesign. Clawd’s two square eyes and the blue beret Dot remain separate silhouettes.

mustFix.action: Restore coherent soft material separation in the visibly affected regions before claiming this whole image finished. Preserve approved staging, foreground exclusivity and the corrected eye designs. Do not replace the composition to address a surface-quality defect.

baselineComparison: 07 and 11 share the dominant composition and subordinated four-cameo layout. 11 supplies the requested flat Grok ovals and dark Muse eyes. In native hero/workshop crops, 07 has smoother cream facial planes, finer Clawd plush and cleaner table/bench material; 11 introduces a stronger cellular pattern and uneven highlights. That makes 07 a useful material-quality control, not a complete replacement for 11’s corrected details.
